Implement the World’s First SSVC-Based Vulnerability Prioritization 

Harness the power of SSVC, CISA’s risk prioritization framework, in combination with SecPod’s Continuous Vulnerability and Exposure Management platform, to effectively and rapidly prioritize security risks. Understand, evaluate, and handle millions of vulnerabilities with ease with Saner CVEM’s Risk Prioritization. 

Gain Exhaustive Visibility into Risks to Reduce Exploitable Attack Surface 

Millions of vulnerabilities make up the exploitable attack surface, and Saner CVEM pin-points the dangerous ones. Rapid reduction of your attack surface is critical to prevent cyberattacks, and risk prioritization is key to understanding and mitigating vulnerabilities quickly and effectively. 

Prioritize Risk with a Lethal Combination of Exploitability Business Impact and Data Analysis 

Leverage an effective amalgamation of exploitability, vulnerability intelligence, business impact, and context to choose and remediate the risks affecting your organization. Speed up your vulnerability management process with integrated vulnerability detection and prioritization. 

Streamline Remediation with Ease with Powerful Saner CVEM Vulnerability Mitigation Engine 

Eliminate vulnerabilities and multiple tools to handle them. Unify detection, assessment, and prioritization to remediate security risks with Saner CVEM’s natively integrated vulnerability management solution. Control and conquer your vulnerabilities with ease and strengthen your security posture. 

Unparalleled Differentiators for an Unbreachable Defense 

SanerNow Vulnerability Management software is built for your modern enterprise to fight the growing risk landscape 
with advanced capabilities to scan, assess, prioritize, and remediate vulnerabilities on devices.

Experience World’s First SSVC-Based Risk Prioritization 

Leverage the latest risk prioritization technology and combat cyberattacks effectively. SanerNow Risk Prioritization classifies security risks into Act, Attend, Track*, and Track based on the SSVC framework developed by CISA, USA, to combat and effectively mitigate the millions of security risks. It combines exploitability, automatability, technical impact, and mission prevalence to categorize and simplify prioritization. 

Harness Data Analysis & Prediction-based Risk Modeling 

By understanding, assessing, and crunching vulnerability and risk data and by using SecPod’s Prediction-based modeling, Saner’s Risk Prioritization harnesses bleeding-edge technology to effectively and rapidly prioritize risk to speed up the vulnerability management process as a whole. 

Gain Powerful Insights into Security Risks 

Often, a lack of information regarding vulnerabilities and security risks can be a reason for ineffectiveness in prioritizing risks. With SecPod world’s largest vulnerability intelligence integrated into Saner’s Risk Prioritization, it provides unprecedented insights into security risks, allowing you to improve your organization’s security posture. 

Automate Prioritizing Risks in Real- Time 

Move away from manual prioritization with the power of automation. With integrated and automated scanning, natively built-in, Saner’s Risk Prioritization continuously assesses newly detected vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, exposures, and anomalies and automatically prioritizes them effectively. By combining the SSVC framework with machine learning, prediction, kill chain validation, and more, Saner further improves vulnerability and risk prioritization. 

Mitigate Risk with Integrated Vulnerability Remediation 

Eliminate multiple tools and broken solutions and replace them with Saner’s Continuous Vulnerability and Exposure Management. Leverage SecPod’s powerful integrated remediation engine to quickly combat dangerous security risks with ease and unify and smoothen the vulnerability management process. 

Configure and Customize Prioritization based on your Organization 

Every organization has a different structure, and generalizing business impact reduces the efficacy of risk prioritization. Saner’s Risk Prioritization can configure and customize risk prioritization based on your organization’s structure and calculate the business impact to tailor-make risk prioritization and significantly reduce the attack surface.

Seamlessly Prioritize Vulnerabilities and Other Risks 
Why stop at software vulnerabilities? Saner CVEM Risk Prioritization not only detects, assesses, and prioritizes CVEs, but also exposure, misconfigurations, and other security risks. With a combination of SSVC and SecPod’s proprietary intelligence, Saner CVEM risk-based vulnerability management (RBVM) makes prioritization seamless and fast, improving resilience and allowing laser-focused remediation efforts to improve organizational security swiftly. 





Get Unprecedented Insights Customization for Better Prioritization 
An ideal risk prioritization tool must provide adjustments and customizations to fit the organization’s requirements. Further, it should also boast an intelligent and comprehensive database. Saner CVEM Risk Prioritization allows granular customizations combined with advanced security risk data for improved prioritization and vulnerability management. 





Remediate Risk that Matters with Integrated Remediation 
Misaligned remediation efforts can drastically impact organizational security. Saner CVEM RBVM, integrated with SecPod’s remediation engine, simplifies and speeds up risk mitigation, unifying vulnerability management and making it continuous and automated. 




Minimize Attack Surface to Maximize Organizational Security 
Remediation reduces the attack surface and minimizes the chance of a vulnerability being exploited. Saner CVEM risk-based vulnerability management (RBVM) speeds up remediation and improves its effectiveness to rapidly and holistically strengthen your organization’s security. 




Harness EPSS & SecPod’s Unique Risk Categorization 
Modern cyberattacks need a modern defense. Go beyond CVSS with a lethal combination of SecPod’s vulnerability intelligence and improved Exploit Prediction Scoring System (EPSS) to prioritize risks, predict potential cyberattacks, and prevent them effectively from breaching your network.
